scope: Original synthetic forward probes, not a real-paper holdout or acceptance benchmark

facts.text: A synthetic robot policy uses a temporal residual code to represent continuous action chunks. Its implementation includes quantile normalization, an MLP, a residual cache, entropy coding, and a lookup decoder.

On two fixed simulated manipulation tasks at matched training budget, coded actions reach 76% and 68% success versus 61% and 57% for per-step binning. Each entry uses 100 executions. No hardware evaluation or training-run uncertainty is available.

A separate released encoder checkpoint is trained once on three source simulators and reused without refitting on two excluded simulators. It averages 24 and 29 tokens per chunk versus 80 and 90 for binning at comparable reconstruction error. No policy-success measurements exist on the excluded simulators.
On the measured workstation, the coded policy takes 180 ms per chunk versus 110 ms for the binning policy. Compression is not a demonstrated inference-speed gain.

cases.author_decision: Give equal priority to the action representation's policy-learning result and the released checkpoint's reuse without refitting. Both are contributions to the abstract. Mechanism internals are supporting detail.

required_meanings: Reusable checkpoint plus no-refitting compression evidence
Reuse evidence is not unseen-simulator policy success
oracle.allowed_omission: Individual module names or per-task inventories

cases.author_decision: The abstract should focus on the action representation's policy-learning result and its measured deployment tradeoff. The released checkpoint is useful supporting material, not a separately prioritized contribution; omit it if needed for a coherent abstract.

required_meanings: Token compression does not imply faster measured inference
oracle.forbidden: Treating every supplied result as an obligatory contribution

cases.author_decision: I want the abstract to present both improved policy learning and a released checkpoint that transfers to new simulators without refitting.
